question_text: Describe the difference between Trainee inheriting Staff and Staff aggregating independent Project objects. Refer to meaning and behaviour reuse.
adaptation_rationale: Retain relationship comparison; avoid false restrictions on reuse or polymorphism in aggregation. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: Trainee is a subtype of Staff and inherits its available attributes/methods, which it may extend or override. Staff has references to Project components, which are independent objects; it can call/delegate to their behaviour rather than becoming a Project subtype.

marking_points.criterion: Trainee inherits and may extend/override parent behaviour.
Staff uses/delegates through Project references rather than inheriting Project identity.
